best_idea: Optimize LSD radix sort with NEON vectorized histogram computation and a three-way digit pass that groups elements by their 8-bit digit, reducing comparisons and enabling better pipelining on Apple Si

best_lineage.idea: Implement an LSD radix sort using 4 passes of 8-bit digits with a single histogram pass per digit, skipping passes when all keys share the same digit, and using NEON intrinsics for the histogram reduction and comparison sort for small partitions, which avoids the merge sort overhead and leverages ARM NEON for speed.
